ops.title: Fresh Sprite startup 92 s target met: 57.186 s with private SquashFS payload + APT closure (v0.9.0)
ops.body:
PR #24 merged 2026-10-02T15:33:30Z as 8739d564 from exactly d47423c; released as v0.9.0 (root verified 4 archives, Developer ID, Apple notarization and cask).

Measured on one fresh real Sprite (d47423c binary, payload built from dadbc59, identical rendered inputs):
- create 57.186 s, exit 0, against a 276.813 s baseline: 4.84x, under the 92.27 s target
- timeline, s from start: allocate 2.3, checkout 11.5, payload 27.2, tools 38.4, tailnet 44.1, packages 44.9, loader 45.6, configure 49.7, publish 56.0, end 57.2
- first SSH with a strict pinned host key 0.507 s; shallow checkout, no node_modules, no PnP
- authenticated Codex agent 16.406 s, 3 shell calls, all exit 0; 28/28 Claude plugins enabled
- payload build one-off 904.940 s, 1,643,491,328 bytes; manifest 92 closure, 37 resident, 1,917 files, 941 generated, 8 consumers

What made the difference:
- a private local SquashFS payload, SHA-256 pinned and streamed over provider exec; no public hosting
- binrun native caches packed into the payload
- an opt-in APT closure captured into the payload and registered via ld.so.conf.d and fontconfig in one locked loader phase
- the readiness deadline
- Sprites Exec makes no API preflight on a successful command (a one-Get classification only after a nonzero exit)

Producer failure classes fixed on the way:
- font-cache loop duplicates: a per-directory first-valid proof
- Apt.Remove packages queried as base: the partition queries only the retained base
- a nested upgraded-base dependency: capture now fails closed with "move C to apt.payload.resident"
- deb seeds now take the real Package field

Open:
- The first 12be producer's exit 137 in plugins verify never recurred and its cause is unknown. Named verify progress and pre-destroy memory evidence are in the release.
- Orca desktop UI registration and render are unverified (the Mac was locked).
- The boot-ID/vmstat/failed-exec-cgroup diagnostic amendment 77c9df1 is unmerged on yasyf/producer-diagnostics.

Evidence: ~/.local/state/cc-remote/setup-20261001/payload-candidate-d47423c…/fresh-timing.json, ssh-first-proof.json, d474-root-acceptance.json.
